channel.title: CivilBook App Updates
channel.description: Stay up-to-date with the latest releases of CivilBook – your trusted On-Demand Home Services app. We're constantly improving to make your experience smoother, faster, and more reliable.

item.title: CivilBook v7.1.0 (Android)
item.description: What's New: Performance improvements for faster app loading • Fixed booking confirmation delay issue • Enhanced notifications for real-time updates • General bug fixes and stability improvements.

item.title: CivilBook v1.0.0 (iOS)
item.description: What's New: First official iOS release • Booking system with real-time availability • In-app chat with service providers • Secure payments & wallet integration.
